plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner story: brand badge, then product, then the 30% OFF message block, ending on a strong CTA at the right edge, with fine print tucked under the button.
Message-first: the 30% OFF headline block leads from the left, the product box sits centered as the visual pivot, and the CTA plus brand badge close the strip on the right as a sign-off group.
Product-anchored bookends: a large product image owns the left end, the copy block runs across the middle, and the brand badge and CTA pair up as a right-hand action cluster with legal beneath.
